title: Proper hypercovers of schemes
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $Y_\bullet$ an augmented simplicial $Z$-scheme, equivalently a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] of $\operatorname{Sch}/Z$. For $n\geq0$ its matching object is the limit in $\operatorname{Sch}/Z$ of its diagram of proper injective faces [lem-weil-pbc-matching-object-proper-faces], equivalently of all lower-dimensional simplices. The canonical matching arrow is induced by the simplicial operators. We call $Y_\bullet\to Z$ a proper hypercover if these matching limits exist and every canonical matching arrow is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. In degree zero the empty matching diagram has terminal object $Z$, so the matching arrow is the augmentation $Y_0\to Z$. No splitting, etaleness, or degreewise dimension bound is part of this definition.
